title: paeonia daurica nothosubsp. lagodechiana
intro: Paeonia daurica nothosubsp. lagodechiana, commonly known as Korean peony, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Paeoniaceae family. It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties, primarily used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Korean peony include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its health benefits and therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties.
